name: GhostCommandPaletteInput
description: Combobox query field. Its keyboard handling mirrors GhostComboboxInput, except that Enter activates the highlighted command instead of selecting it. Typing writes the root search and emits search.

props.name: as
props.description: Tag name or component rendered for the query field.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables typing and activation from this input.

parts.name: input
parts.description: Field with class ghost-command-palette-input and data-part="input".

states.name: open
states.description: data-state="open" while the palette is open.

keyboard.ArrowDown: Highlights the next enabled command (wraps) and updates aria-activedescendant on the input.
keyboard.Enter: Activates the highlighted command: emits command with its id and, with closeOnSelect, closes. Never commits a selection or rewrites the query.
keyboard.Escape: Clears the highlight and closes the palette when closeOnEscape is true; focus returns to the opener.
